brief: Numerous circular shapes radiate with soft, warm light across a dark canvas. They drift slowly across the screen, expanding and contracting rhythmically on their own without user interaction. Occasionally, a new orb pulses into existence at a random location while older ones fade into the background. No mouse movement or click alters the drifting field, ensuring the animation feels like an autonomous, living atmosphere. The visuals rely entirely on smooth gradient transitions and subtle color shifts within the glowing spheres to maintain visual interest.
